title: Decision: a client-visible call-room primitive, with a one-call agent convenience over it
description:
Mark decided 2026-11-23, for bead mimid-1wgh.108's agent half.

THE QUESTION. A call needs its own room (decision mimid-96tt's
analysis, draft-atwood-mimi-calls §4.1). Who creates it: the agent, from
the parent's membership, or the client, through room primitives?

CHOSEN: both. A primitive the client can drive, and a one-call
convenience on top of it.

WHY BOTH RATHER THAN EITHER:
- mimid ships no UI (decision mimid-1wgh.38) and exists to serve stock
  clients. A stock JMAP Chat client will never learn what a
  parent-dependent room is, so if starting a call needs that knowledge,
  such a client can never offer a call. The convenience is what makes
  calls reach the clients mimid is for.
- The flexible shapes are real and we should not foreclose them: a call
  among a subset, a persistent room, a call that outlives the chat. Our
  own draft-atwood-jmap-vtc already treats `chatId` as an OPTIONAL
  binding on a call, so a client-driven call that merely happens to be
  bound to a chat is the shape that draft assumes. Hiding the room
  behind a single action would contradict it.
- The division falls out of who knows what. The agent knows the parent
  room's membership; the client knows whom the user wants to call. "Call
  this chat" is the agent's to answer; "call these three people" is the
  client's.

COST ACCEPTED: two supported paths into the same state, and twice the
surface to keep correct. Mitigate it the obvious way -- the convenience
is implemented IN TERMS OF the primitive, with no second code path to
the room, so there is one thing to get right and one thing to test, and
the convenience is a participant-list choice plus a call to the
primitive.

SHAPE TO BUILD, in this order:
1. The primitive: HostOptions gains the ability to ask for a
   parent-dependent room, which agent.rs cannot do today
   (`parent_room: vec![]` is hardcoded). Takes the parent's room id and
   the participants.
2. A Store action for the media secret of a call room, over
   mimi-mls Member::safe_export_secret with component MEDIA_KEYS
   (decision mimid-1wgh.112).
3. The convenience: one Store action that takes the parent room and
   starts a call in it, defaulting the participants to the parent's
   membership, which decision mimid-1wgh.110's subset reading allows.
   A later argument narrows it to a subset.
4. The JMAP surface, so a stock client can reach 3. That is where the
   VTC capability on the agent's endpoint comes in, which mimid does not
   serve yet.

Steps 1 to 3 are what the keying demo needs; 4 is what a user needs.
